Message.Name: Polling Data Message
Message.Description: Polling data transmitted at one-minute intervals on every market data feed. Carries Current Time as a heartbeat.

Field.Name: Current Time
Field.Description: Current time in HHMM format, transmitted at one-minute intervals.

Field.Name: End Keyword
Field.Description: End of text sentinel (0xFF) marking the end of the message.

Message.Name: Krx Index Message
Message.Description: Krx Index real-time message. Reports current index value, change against previous day, accumulated trading volume, and accumulated trading value for one index. The Index ID field identifies which index group (KRX Index Group 1/2/3, Sector A/B, Gold Spot, or Equity Derivatives) this record belongs to.

Field.Name: Index ID
Field.Description: Index identifier. Refer to Code Table sheet "Index List by Contracts (Real-Time)".

Field.Name: ISIN Code
Field.Description: ISIN code for the index. Refer to Code Table sheet "Index List by Contracts (Real-Time)".

Field.Name: Calculation Time
Field.Description: Index calculation time. During market hours: HHMMSS (time:min:sec). End of the regular session: final calculation timestamp.

Field.Name: Index
Field.Description: Current index value (9 ASCII digits with 2 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Index Change Sign Against The Previous Day
Field.Description: Sign of the index change against the previous day. '+' ascended, ' ' unchanged, '-' declined.

Field.Name: Index Change Against The Previous Day
Field.Description: Magnitude of the index change against the previous day (9 ASCII digits with 2 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Accumulated Trading Volume
Field.Description: Accumulated trading volume of the index constituents (12 ASCII digits). Unit: 1,000 shares.

Field.Name: Accumulated Trading Value
Field.Description: Accumulated trading value of the index constituents (12 ASCII digits). Unit: Million KRW.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Reserved filler. Always 4 ASCII space characters.

Field.Name: End Keyword
Field.Description: End of text sentinel (0xFF) marking the end of the message.

Message.Name: Krx Estimated Index Message
Message.Description: Krx Estimated Index real-time message. Reports the estimated index value during the pre-opening simultaneous-trading window or during regular session estimation. Identical field layout to the Krx Index Message.

Field.Name: Index ID
Field.Description: Index identifier. Refer to Code Table sheet "Index List by Contracts (Real-Time)".

Field.Name: ISIN Code
Field.Description: ISIN code for the index. Refer to Code Table sheet "Index List by Contracts (Real-Time)".

Field.Name: Calculation Time
Field.Description: Index calculation time. During market hours: HHMMSS. Pre-opening simultaneous trade: HHMMSS at calculation tick.

Field.Name: Index
Field.Description: Current estimated index value (9 ASCII digits with 2 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Index Change Sign Against The Previous Day
Field.Description: Sign of the index change against the previous day. '+' ascended, ' ' unchanged, '-' declined.

Field.Name: Index Change Against The Previous Day
Field.Description: Magnitude of the estimated index change against the previous day (9 ASCII digits with 2 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Accumulated Trading Volume
Field.Description: Accumulated trading volume of the index constituents (12 ASCII digits). Unit: 1,000 shares.

Field.Name: Accumulated Trading Value
Field.Description: Accumulated trading value of the index constituents (12 ASCII digits). Unit: Million KRW.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Reserved filler. Always 4 ASCII space characters.

Field.Name: End Keyword
Field.Description: End of text sentinel (0xFF) marking the end of the message.

Message.Name: Global Index Message
Message.Description: Global Index real-time message. Reports the current value of a foreign index referenced by KRX (e.g. Korea-Taiwan IT Premier, Korea-China Index) in the index's native currency.

Field.Name: Index ID
Field.Description: Global index identifier. Refer to Code Table sheet "Index List by Contracts (Real-Time)".

Field.Name: ISIN Code
Field.Description: ISIN code for the global index. Refer to Code Table sheet "Index List by Contracts (Real-Time)".

Field.Name: Business Date
Field.Description: Business date for the index calculation in YYYYMMDD format.

Field.Name: Calculation Time
Field.Description: Index calculation time. During market hours: HHMMSS. End of regular session: final calculation timestamp.

Field.Name: Index
Field.Description: Current global index value (9 ASCII digits with 2 implied decimal places) in the index native currency.

Field.Name: Index Change Sign Against The Previous Day
Field.Description: Sign of the index change against the previous day. '+' ascended, ' ' unchanged, '-' declined.

Field.Name: Index Change Against The Previous Day
Field.Description: Magnitude of the index change against the previous day (9 ASCII digits with 2 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Currency Code
Field.Description: ISO 4217 currency code of the index value.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Reserved filler. Always 4 ASCII space characters.

Field.Name: End Keyword
Field.Description: End of text sentinel (0xFF) marking the end of the message.

Message.Name: Bond Prime Index Message
Message.Description: Bond Prime Index intraday calculation. Reports clean and total-earnings index values plus their weighted variants and average duration / convexity / yield for one Group Code and Maturity Code pair.

Field.Name: Calculating Date
Field.Description: Calculation date in YYYYMMDD format.

Field.Name: Calculating Time
Field.Description: Calculation time in HHMMSS plus two trailing spaces.

Field.Name: Group Code
Field.Description: Bond Prime Index Group Code. JA000 group identifier; check the TR-CODE for the specific group.

Field.Name: Maturity Code
Field.Description: Bond Prime Index Maturity Code. JA000 maturity identifier; check the TR-CODE for the specific maturity bucket.

Field.Name: Clean Price Index
Field.Description: Clean price index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Total Earnings Index
Field.Description: Total earnings index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Clean Price Index Weight
Field.Description: Weighted clean price index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Total Earnings Index Weight
Field.Description: Weighted total earnings index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Weight Of Clean Index Value For Integrity Index Weight
Field.Description: Integrity-index weight for the clean index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Weight Of Sum Index Value For Integrity Index Weight
Field.Description: Integrity-index weight for the sum index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Average Duration
Field.Description: Average duration across the index constituents (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Average Convexity
Field.Description: Average convexity across the index constituents (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Average YLD
Field.Description: Average yield across the index constituents (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places). Unit: percent.

Field.Name: Transmission Time
Field.Description: Transmission time in HHMMSSMM format (8 ASCII digits).

Field.Name: End Keyword
Field.Description: End of text sentinel (0xFF) marking the end of the message.

Message.Name: Bond Ktb Index Message
Message.Description: Bond KTB Index intraday calculation. Reports total profit, clean price, market price, call and zero re-investment indices, futures basis price, duration, convexity, and YTM for one KTB-based Bond Index ID.

Field.Name: Bond Index ID
Field.Description: Bond index identifier. Examples: BGG01T (KTB Index), BGG03T (KTB 10Y Index).

Field.Name: Base Date
Field.Description: Base date for the index calculation in YYYYMMDD format.

Field.Name: Base Time
Field.Description: Base time for the index calculation in HHMMSS format.

Field.Name: Total Profit Index
Field.Description: Total profit index (11 ASCII digits with 4 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Clean Price Index
Field.Description: Clean price index (11 ASCII digits with 4 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Market Price Index
Field.Description: Market price index (11 ASCII digits with 4 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Call Re-Investment Index
Field.Description: Call re-investment index (11 ASCII digits with 4 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Zero Re-Investment Index
Field.Description: Zero re-investment index (11 ASCII digits with 4 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Futures Basis Price
Field.Description: Futures basis price (10 ASCII digits with 2 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Duration
Field.Description: Bond index average duration (7 ASCII digits with 3 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Convexity
Field.Description: Bond index average convexity (7 ASCII digits with 3 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Average YTM
Field.Description: Average yield to maturity (7 ASCII digits with 3 implied decimal places). Unit: percent.

Field.Name: Average ForwardYTM
Field.Description: Average forward yield to maturity (7 ASCII digits with 3 implied decimal places). Unit: percent.

Field.Name: End Keyword
Field.Description: End of text sentinel (0xFF) marking the end of the message.

Message.Name: Bond Ktb Index Term Structure Message
Message.Description: Bond KTB Index TermStructure. One record per ISIN constituent of a KTB Index showing its basis price, clean price, YTM, and the Index Constituent flag.

Field.Name: Bond Index ID
Field.Description: Bond index identifier. Examples: BGG01T (KTB Index), BGG03T (KTB 10Y Index).

Field.Name: Base Date
Field.Description: Base date for the index calculation in YYYYMMDD format.

Field.Name: Base Time
Field.Description: Base time for the index calculation in HHMMSS format.

Field.Name: ISIN Code
Field.Description: ISIN code of the bond constituent.

Field.Name: Basis Price
Field.Description: Basis price of the constituent (10 ASCII digits with 2 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Clean Price
Field.Description: Clean price of the constituent (10 ASCII digits with 2 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Average YTM
Field.Description: Average yield to maturity for the constituent (7 ASCII digits with 3 implied decimal places). Unit: percent.

Field.Name: Index Constituent
Field.Description: Flag identifying whether the security is included in the index. '0' securities are included in the ETF but not in the Index; '1' securities are included in the Index.

Field.Name: End Keyword
Field.Description: End of text sentinel (0xFF) marking the end of the message.

Message.Name: Bond Index Krx Message
Message.Description: KRX Aggregate Bond Index (AA- or higher) end-of-day index data. Reports clean-price, total-earnings, market-price, and re-investment indices, their weighted variants, integrity-index weights, average duration, convexity, yield, coupon, remaining maturity, spread, market capitalization, and accumulated cash flows for one Bond Index ID.

Field.Name: Message Sequence Number
Field.Description: Message sequence number assigned by the Market Engine.

Field.Name: Calculating Date
Field.Description: Calculation date in YYYYMMDD format.

Field.Name: Index ID
Field.Description: Bond index identifier. Example: BGG04T (KRX Aggregate Bond AA- or higher Index).

Field.Name: Clean Price Index
Field.Description: Clean price index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Total Earnings Index
Field.Description: Total earnings index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Market Price Index
Field.Description: Market price index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Zero Re-Investment Index
Field.Description: Zero re-investment index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Call Re-Investment Index
Field.Description: Call re-investment index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Clean Price Index Weight
Field.Description: Weighted clean price index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Total Earnings Index Weight
Field.Description: Weighted total earnings index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Market Price Index Weight
Field.Description: Weighted market price index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Zero Re-Investment Index Weight
Field.Description: Weighted zero re-investment index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Call Re-Investment Index Weight
Field.Description: Weighted call re-investment index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Weight Of Clean Index Value For Integrity Index Weight
Field.Description: Integrity-index weight for the clean index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Weight Of Sum Index Value For Integrity Index Weight
Field.Description: Integrity-index weight for the sum index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Weight Of Zero Re-Investment Index Value For Integrity Index Weight
Field.Description: Integrity-index weight for the zero re-investment index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Weight Of Call Re-Investment Index Value For Integrity Index Weight
Field.Description: Integrity-index weight for the call re-investment index value (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Average Duration
Field.Description: Average duration across the index constituents (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Average Convexity
Field.Description: Average convexity across the index constituents (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Average YLD
Field.Description: Average yield across the index constituents (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Average Coupon Price
Field.Description: Average coupon price (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Average Remaining Maturity Price
Field.Description: Average remaining maturity (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places). Unit: year.

Field.Name: Average Current Yield
Field.Description: Average current yield (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Average Spread Sign
Field.Description: Sign of the average spread. '+' ascended, ' ' unchanged, '-' declined.

Field.Name: Average Spread
Field.Description: Magnitude of the average spread (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Index Number Of Securities
Field.Description: Number of constituent securities included in the index (8 ASCII digits).

Field.Name: Issued Amount
Field.Description: Total issued amount across constituents (20 ASCII digits). Unit: KRW.

Field.Name: Issued Amount Weight
Field.Description: Weighted issued amount (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Index Market Capitalization
Field.Description: Total market capitalization of the index constituents (20 ASCII digits). Unit: KRW.

Field.Name: Market Capitalization Weight
Field.Description: Weighted market capitalization (16 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Accumulated Cash
Field.Description: Accumulated cash position (26 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Cash Inflow
Field.Description: Cash inflow during the calculation period (26 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: Reinvest Call Cash
Field.Description: Reinvested call cash during the calculation period (26 ASCII digits with 6 implied decimal places).

Field.Name: End Keyword
Field.Description: End of text sentinel (0xFF) marking the end of the message.
